name: nullbrand-desktop
description: Electron shell that packages nullbrand as a desktop app. Build tooling only: nothing here is a dependency of the core in ../src.

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run stage && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck: npm run stage && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test dist/test-build/test/*.test.js
scripts.start: npm run build && node node_modules/electron/install.js && node scripts/start.mjs
scripts.package:release: npm run build && electron-builder --config builder.release.mjs --publish never
